text_block_list.text:
And just like that, the 4th Live came to 
an end in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much, everyone, for coming 
today.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
It was fantastic! Thank YOU so much~! Good 
luck at the Grand Live~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ………… Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka stayed on stage for a 
while, listening to the cheers of the 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I shall be taking my leave ahead 
of you. I need you to measure the pulse 
rate of every single Umamusume who 
attended right away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In order to substantiate a deduced 
hypothesis, a daily accumulation of 
efforts like this is vital, you see.
choice_data_list: What is it that you want to prove?
What is it you want to prove?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Who knows?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...If I had to put a word to it, maybe a 
"wish"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope the cheers heard from the fans 
during the live performance gave <chrname> strength 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having heard about the Grand Live and 
choosing to join, I hope her own heartfelt 
wishes are fulfilled up on that stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Hoping for that to be true might just 
be my own wishful thinking as someone who 
supports her.
...'Ainer...! ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to bother you when you're busy, 
but there is something I just have to talk 
to you about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"I'm thinking of asking the academy to let 
me hold an 'Information Session for the 
Grand Live' soon."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Through the promotional live 
performances with everyone, more Umamusume 
came to lend their support. Thanks to 
that, we gained a whole lot of fans too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Which is precisely why I must 
sincerely face whatever lingering doubts 
remain."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There are people to whom I must provide a 
convincing explanation for holding the 
Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Umamusume of the academy, and the 
URA board of directors.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
While continuing to petition the board of 
directors, I decided that I must first 
deliver my message directly to the 
students of the Academy myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Wishing for a concert for the Umamusume 
and the fans... ...as a single fan 
myself."
choice_data_list:
I'll try talking to Chairwoman Akikawa 
about it too.

I'll try consulting Chairwoman Akikawa 
too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh, please don't say that. You've already 
helped me more than enough, Trainer. 
Putting any more burden on you would be—
choice_data_list: I'm a fan too, so I want to help out.
I'm a fan too, so I want to help!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I look forward to working 
with you. Please stay with me until the 
very end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later, together with Light 
Hello, I headed to the chairwoman's office 
at the academy and obtained permission for 
the Grand Live briefing session.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything is for the Grand Live. Let's 
give it our all to keep supporting them!
